_comment: COPY THIS to bootstrap.parameters.json (gitignored) and run as a subscription Owner. See infra/azure/README.md, 'CI'.
githubSubjectPrefix: the default is the IMMUTABLE subject form. Opt the repository into immutable subject claims
BEFORE the first run, or set the legacy prefix repo:gesco-healthcare-support/hcs-patient-portal instead.
appDeployTargets: leave both names empty for PHASE 1. After the infrastructure deploy's phase 1 has created the
registry and the VM, fill them in from its outputs (registryLoginServer without the domain, hostName) and run again.
